cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Initial Report Request screen renders with entry fields, legend and key line
cases.precondition: F-STD. The operator opens Report Request (transaction ORRP) from the main menu for the first time.
cases.steps:
1. Select the Report Request function from the main menu
2. Observe the freshly painted screen
cases.expected: The entry form is shown: the Report Type, From Date and To Date fields are empty and ready for input; the guidance prompt 「Type 01=Bills 02=Trans, dates YYYY-MM-DD.」 appears on the message line; the option legend 「1=Trans 2=Accts 3=Cards」 and the key line 「ENTER=Process  PF3=Back  PF4=Clear」 are displayed.
cases.remark: MREPTA (SDD-MAP-025) · 1000-SEND-INITIAL L86-96 · legend field 16 is stale vs accepted 01/02 (NOTES discrepancy 1)

cases.mid: 初期値・デフォルト (Initial values / defaults)
cases.name: Header line and current date/time are auto-populated on open
cases.precondition: F-STD. First entry to the Report Request screen.
cases.steps:
1. Open the Report Request screen
2. Check the header line and the date/time fields
cases.expected: The header shows the transaction id 「ORRP」, the program name 「OCREPT」 and the system title 「ORION CREDIT CARD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM」; the current date (e.g. 2026-09-28) and current time are filled from the system clock. The three input fields stay empty.

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Run the Bills report (type 01) over a date range
cases.steps:
1. Open the Report Request screen
2. Enter Report Type = 01 (Bills)
3. Enter From Date = 2025-01-01, To Date = 2025-12-31
4. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The bill file is browsed for payment dates in the range; B1 (100.00), B2 (250.00), B3 (500.00) and B5 (300.00) match and B4 (2024-12-31) is excluded. The summary line reads 「Type 01 Count: 4 Total: 1,150.00」. The screen stays on the Report Request screen.

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Run the Trans report (type 02) over a date range
cases.steps:
1. Open the Report Request screen
2. Enter Report Type = 02 (Trans)
3. Enter From Date = 2025-01-01, To Date = 2025-12-31
4. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The transaction file is browsed on the original-timestamp date in the range; T1 (50.00), T2 (200.00) and T3 (125.00) match and T4 (2024-11-11) is excluded. The summary line reads 「Type 02 Count: 3 Total: 375.00」. The screen stays on the Report Request screen.

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Only in-range records are counted; count and total are edited
cases.steps:
1. Open the Report Request screen
2. Enter Report Type = 01 (Bills)
3. Enter From Date = 2025-02-01, To Date = 2025-06-30
4. Press ENTER
cases.expected: Only in-range bills are counted: B2 (2025-03-15, 250.00) and B3 (2025-06-30, 500.00); B1 (2025-01-10), B5 (2025-07-01) and B4 are excluded. The summary reads 「Type 01 Count: 2 Total: 750.00」 — the count is an unsigned integer and the total carries thousands separators and two decimals.
cases.remark: count WS-RPT-COUNT→WS-ED-CNT (ZZZZZZ9) · total WS-TOTAL→WS-ED-TOT (-,---,---,---,--9.99) · 2400 STRING L358-362

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF3 returns to the main menu
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Report Request screen is displayed.
cases.steps: 1. On the Report Request screen, press PF3
cases.expected: The transaction hands control back to the main menu; the Report Request screen is left and the main menu is shown.

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF4 clears the entered values and repaints the empty form
cases.precondition: F-STD. On the Report Request screen the operator has typed a report type and dates.
cases.steps:
1. Type Report Type = 01, From Date = 2025-01-01, To Date = 2025-12-31 (do not press ENTER)
2. Press PF4
cases.expected: The entered values are cleared and the empty entry form is repainted (the guidance prompt is shown again as on first display). The operator can start a new entry.

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: First entry shows the form; a later ENTER processes it (pseudo-conversational)
cases.precondition: F-STD. The transaction ORRP is started fresh (no prior communication area).
cases.steps:
1. Start the Report Request transaction (first entry)
2. Observe the screen
3. Enter Report Type = 01, From Date = 2025-01-01, To Date = 2025-12-31 and press ENTER
cases.expected: On the first entry the empty entry form is shown and nothing is processed. After the form is returned, pressing ENTER is treated as a data submission and the report runs, showing the summary line. The transaction re-drives itself under id 「ORRP」 between the two steps.

cases.mid: 連携・インターフェース (Linkage / interface)
cases.name: Both dates are validated through the date-utility subroutine before the report runs
cases.steps:
1. Open the Report Request screen
2. Enter Report Type = 01, From Date = 2025-01-01, To Date = 2025-12-31
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: Each date is passed to the date-utility subroutine for validation; it returns an OK status for the two genuine dates, so the report proceeds and the summary 「Type 01 Count: 4 Total: 1,150.00」 is shown. No date-error message appears.
cases.remark: CALL OUDATE KD-FUNC='VALD' L192/L201 · KD-STATUS='00' → proceed · validator OUDATE 2000-VALIDATE

cases.expected: The message 「Report type is required.」 is shown on the message line; no report is run and the screen stays for correction.

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: From date is not a valid calendar date
cases.steps:
1. Open the Report Request screen
2. Enter Report Type = 01
3. Enter From Date = 2025-13-01 (month 13), To Date = 2025-12-31
4. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The date-utility subroutine rejects the from date because the month is outside 01–12, so the message 「From date is not a valid date.」 is shown; no report is run.
cases.remark: 2130 CALL OUDATE (from) KD-STATUS NOT='00' L189-196 · OUDATE month<1 or >12

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: To date is not a valid calendar date
cases.steps:
1. Open the Report Request screen
2. Enter Report Type = 01
3. Enter From Date = 2025-01-01, To Date = 2025-04-31 (April has 30 days)
4. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The from date passes but the to date is rejected because day 31 exceeds a 30-day month, so the message 「To date is not a valid date.」 is shown; no report is run.
cases.remark: 2130 CALL OUDATE (to) KD-STATUS NOT='00' L198-205 · OUDATE Apr=30 days

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: From date is later than to date
cases.steps:
1. Open the Report Request screen
2. Enter Report Type = 01
3. Enter From Date = 2025-12-31, To Date = 2025-01-01
4. Press ENTER
cases.expected: Both dates are individually valid but the from date is after the to date, so the message 「From date is later than to date.」 is shown; no report is run.
cases.remark: 2130-VALIDATE-DATES WS-FROM-DATE > WS-TO-DATE L207-209 (string compare on ISO dates)

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Bill browse cannot start (bill file unavailable)
cases.precondition: F-STD, but the bill file is made unavailable (e.g. not allocated or disabled) so starting the browse returns an abnormal response (neither success nor not-found).
cases.steps:
1. Open the Report Request screen
2. Enter Report Type = 01, From Date = 2025-01-01, To Date = 2025-12-31
3. Press ENTER
cases.data: Report Type=01; From=2025-01-01; To=2025-12-31; bill file unavailable *(needs real data)*
cases.expected: The browse cannot start, so the message 「Error starting bill browse.」 is shown; no count or total is produced.

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: An unsupported key is pressed
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Report Request screen is displayed.
cases.steps: 1. On the Report Request screen, press an unsupported key such as PF12
cases.expected: The screen is repainted and the message 「Invalid key pressed. Please try again.」 is shown; the operator can retry with a supported key.

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Report type needs the exact 2-character code (leading zero)
cases.steps:
1. Open the Report Request screen
2. Enter Report Type = 1 (single digit, no leading zero), From = 2025-01-01, To = 2025-12-31
3. Press ENTER
4. Re-enter Report Type = 01 and press ENTER
cases.expected: Step 3: 「1」 (held as 「1 」, not 「01」) is rejected with 「Report type must be 01 or 02.」. Step 4: 「01」 is accepted and the bills summary 「Type 01 Count: 4 Total: 1,150.00」 is shown — confirming the 2-character code with leading zero is required.
cases.remark: RPTYPE picin len=2 · WS-RPT-TYPE X(02) 88 RPT-BILLS='01' · 2120 L168-170

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Date-range lower bound is inclusive
cases.steps:
1. Open the Report Request screen
2. Enter Report Type = 01, From Date = 2025-03-15, To Date = 2025-12-31
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: B2, dated exactly on the from date 2025-03-15, IS counted (lower bound inclusive); B1 (2025-01-10), before the from date, is excluded. The summary reads 「Type 01 Count: 3 Total: 1,050.00」 (B2 250.00 + B3 500.00 + B5 300.00).

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Date-range upper bound is inclusive
cases.steps:
1. Open the Report Request screen
2. Enter Report Type = 01, From Date = 2025-01-01, To Date = 2025-06-30
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: B3, dated exactly on the to date 2025-06-30, IS counted (upper bound inclusive); B5 (2025-07-01), one day after the to date, is excluded. The summary reads 「Type 01 Count: 3 Total: 850.00」 (B1 100.00 + B2 250.00 + B3 500.00).

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: February 29 accepted in a non-leap year (date-utility quirk)
cases.steps:
1. Open the Report Request screen
2. Enter Report Type = 01, From Date = 2025-02-29, To Date = 2025-12-31
3. Press ENTER
4. Change From Date = 2025-02-30 and press ENTER
cases.expected: Step 3: 2025-02-29 is accepted as a valid date even though 2025 is not a leap year (the date utility treats February as 29 days), so the report runs. Step 4: 2025-02-30 is rejected with 「From date is not a valid date.」 (day 30 exceeds February's 29).
cases.remark: OUDATE 2000-VALIDATE WHEN 2 → WS-DIM=29 (no leap test) L63-64,71 · quirk (NOTES discrepancy 3)

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: No records in the range → zero count
cases.steps:
1. Open the Report Request screen
2. Enter Report Type = 01, From Date = 2020-01-01, To Date = 2020-12-31
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: No bill falls in the range, so the count is zero and the summary reads 「Type 01 Count: 0 Total: 0.00」. No error message is shown (an empty file behaves the same way).
cases.remark: 2220 in-range test false for all → WS-RPT-COUNT/WS-TOTAL stay 0 · empty file NOTFND 2210 L243-244

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Single-day range (from date equals to date)
cases.steps:
1. Open the Report Request screen
2. Enter Report Type = 01, From Date = 2025-06-30, To Date = 2025-06-30
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The range covers a single day; only B3 (2025-06-30) matches because both bounds are equal and inclusive. The summary reads 「Type 01 Count: 1 Total: 500.00」.
cases.remark: 2220 WS-REC-DATE >= From AND <= To with From=To L263
